verdict.rationale: Solid is built on familiar tools: JSX and TypeScript. Components are plain JavaScript functions, so you 'don't have to learn a new rendering system', and a `<div>` is a real DOM div. Developers coming from React and Vue report a painless, intuitive transition, though some note reactivity gotchas such as the special props object and props needing to be accessed reactively. missing for 10: any evidence about styling/CSS approach, evidence that the new reactivity concepts (signals, props-object rules) don't add learning overhead, and documentation addressing the reported non-intuitive API and naming conventions.
